name: Deaerator vent condensers and feedtank internals (spray nozzles, trays, sparge pipes)
description: Mechanically remove dissolved oxygen and carbon dioxide by heating feedwater to saturation and breaking it into droplets/thin sheets in a steam atmosphere; collect deaerated water in a storage section under a steam blanket; vent non-condensables with a small controlled steam loss. Feedtank internals condense returned flash steam and mix cold make-up uniformly. Primary source: https://www.spiraxsarco.com/learn-about-steam/the-boiler-house/pressurised-deaerators
